svg.title: Azure Cost Optimizer: application, evidence and Microsoft Foundry
svg.desc: Official embedded Azure icons. Container Apps hosts the self-hosted Agent ACO and eight read-only tools. Foundry hosts the model. Dashed paths show optional MCP prompt agents, evaluation, trace, and governance integrations; these are not claimed as configured. Managed identity and application authorization guard the workload. No private network or production certification is implied.

g.text: One curated application. One financial engine. Microsoft Foundry for models and optional agent lifecycle integrations.
React workspace / grounded answers / charts / PDF and Excel
Container Apps environment; one ASP.NET Core process
React static assets + ASP.NET Core API
Agent ACO runs here using Microsoft Agent Framework
8 in-process tools | scope + principal + report binding
Optional /mcp transport: the same tools + describe_data_sources
Exact decimal normalization, cost totals and source receipts
Advisor interpretation, evidence validity and report generation
The language model never owns authoritative financial totals.
Authenticated connection to the ACO tools
Restore to memory; generate PDF/XLSX from the cached revision
Not CSV rows or report files
Enabled only with the relevant configuration
Safe OpenTelemetry; no raw billing rows
Not implemented by this workshop; separate adapter, identity, tenant approval and spend review required
No automatic publication or React UI parity
Future authenticated adapter - Microsoft 365 Agents SDK / Toolkit
Preserve self-hosted Agent ACO and scope-bound evidence
Alternative: separately publish a verified Foundry prompt agent
Numbers match the workflow below. Solid lines: primary paths. Dashed lines: optional or configuration-dependent integrations.
Official Microsoft icons are embedded unmodified. This workshop does not claim private networking or production certification.
